Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players of Afghanistan stride out to the middle. Scott Edwards and Colin Ackermann will open the batting for Netherlands. Fazal Haque will start with the ball. Here we go..
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Netherlands require 255 runs from 50 overs to deny a whitewash! It isn't the easiest of wickets to bat on and they will need to bat out of their skins against a strong bowling attack of Afghanistan to chase this down. Who will come out victorious? We'll find that soon as the chase begins shortly.

Netherlands were asked to bowl first and their bowlers were right on the money at the start of the innings. They kept things tight in the middle and did not give away any freebies to the Afghan batters. The debutant, Clayton Floyd got rid of the dangerous Gurbaz and that set the tone for the Dutch. However, they failed to chip in with wickets after that and took their foot off the pedal. Saqib Zulfiqar got the much-needed breakthrough as he dismissed Riaz Hussan and brought the Dutch back into the contest. Their spinners bowled well and managed to keep the batters in check. A total of 8 bowlers were used by Pieter Seelaar but it was Netherlands' pacers who took a bit of a hammering at the end overs. The Dutch bowled well for the majority of the innings but gave away 87 runs in the last 10 overs and also their momentum.

Having opted to bat first, Afghanistan got off to a sedate start and they lost their centurion of the last game, Rahmanullah Gurbaz cheaply in the 10th over. It was Riaz Hussan and Rahmat Shah who did the repair work and they ensured that Afghanistan keep wickets in hand for the end overs. They stitched together a stand of 86 runs before Hussan perished. Shah fell soon after and then it was the partnership between Shahidi and Zadran that took Afghanistan to safer shores. Zadran also brought up his fifty in the process and it was his innings of 71 runs off just 59 balls which shifted the momentum completely in Afghanistan'a favour. Rashid Khan and Azmatullah Omarzai also played a handy cameo at the end and ensured that Afghanistan finished strong.

A good batting performance from Afghanistan in the final ODI of the series and it is the innings of Najibullah Zadran which has propelled them to go past the 250-run mark. Netherlands have bowled well in patches and they would be slightly dejected as they did leak some runs at the fag end.

A length delivery on middle. Rashid Khan heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. So just a single to end the innings but this has been a good cameo by Rashid Khan. Afghanistan finish with 254/5 after 50 overs.
A shorter delivery outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai manages to cut it towards deep cover for a single. He has to reach for it and does well to get a bat on it.
A fuller delivery on off. Khan heaves it towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Rashid Khan, the rockstar gets into the act now! A shorter delivery on off. Rashid Khan pulls it stongly over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.  Something like a helicopter-pull this by Rashid Khan.
A fuller delivery outside off. Khan steers it to deep covers for another couple of runs.
A good yorker on middle. Rashid Khan digs it out past mid on for a couple.
Who will bowl the last over of the innings? It is Brandon Glover.
FOUR! Good end to the over! A shorter length delivery on off. Azmatullah Omarzai pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A fuller delivery on off. Khan drives it to covers for a single.
Rashid Khan walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Najibullah Zadran has to walk back now. No problem with overstepping this time. A fuller delivery outside off. Zadran looks to go inside out over covers but gets an outside edge. The ball goes back to the keeper and Scott Edwards there makes no mistake. End of an entertaining innings from Najibullah Zadran. He has taken Afghanistan to a good total here. Vivian Kingma gets the much-deserved wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Vivian Kingma

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This time it is on a length, on off. Najibullah Zadran hammers it over long on for a biggie. That no ball can prove very costly now. Najibullah Zadran is a dangerous batter.
A very full delivery outside off. Zadran looks to drive but misses. Good comeback by Vivian Kingma.

NO BALL! Najibullah Zadran survives and this is quite unlucky for Netherlands! Vivian Kingma does everything right but ends up overstepping and Najibullah Zadran who was walking back to the pavilion has another chance to take Afghanistan to a big total here. This is bowed fuller outside off and is slower in pace. Najibullah Zadran looks to get under it and play it over covers. He gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes straight into the hands of cover fielder in the ring. Najibullah Zadran starts walking back to the pavilion but the replays show that Vivian Kingma has overstepped here and Najibullah Zadran gets a life here. Free Hit coming up.
Is this is a no ball? The umpires are checking the front foot of Vivian Kingma. Oh, dear! Look away, Kingma! The replays have comfirmed that Kingma has overstepped and so it is a no ball.
A slower length ball, on off. Azmatullah Omarzai heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Dot to end the over! Aryan Dutt has been superb! A flatter ball on middle. Najibullah Zadran plays it back to the bowler.
Just a single again! A fuller delivery outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai goes for a big heave but only manages to hit it towards deep cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Najibullah Zadran reverse-sweeps it to short third man for a single.
Darted on the pads this time. Najibullah Zadran goes for a big heave but misses and the ball hits his pads.
Nice change of pace! A fuller delivery on middle. Azmatullah Omarzai heaves it off the inside half of his blade to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Najibullah Zadran makes room and hits it to covers for a single.
Dot to end a good over for Afghanistan! A length delivery on middle. Azmatullah Omarzai backs away and looks to slap it but gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes back to the keeper.
A length ball, on off. Najibullah Zadran heaves it off the inside half of his blade to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! In the slot and Najibullah Zadran is not going to miss out! A length delivery on off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and tonks it high and handsome over long on for a biggie.
On a length, around leg. Najibullah Zadran looks to clip it but the ball brushes his pads and goes back to the keeper.
SIX! This time an even better shot! Short delivery on off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and just hammers it over long off with horizontal bat shot for a biggie.
FOUR! Fifty for Najibullah Zadran! Exactly the kind of innings Afghanistan needed! A shorter length delivery outside off. Najibullah Zadran slaps it towards deep extra-cover for a boundary.
Brandon Glover (8-0-34-1) is back on.

FOUR! So a much-needed boundary to end the over! A shorter length delivery on off. Azmatullah Omarzai rocks back and pulls it wide of long on. The fielder there runs across and tries to stop it but fails to do so and the ball goes for a boundary. Sloppy work there.
A shorter delivery on off. Najibullah Zadran punches it to deep cover for a single.
An appeal but turned down! A flatter delivery on middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran looks to reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal but no damage done.
Flatter on middle. Azmatullah Omarzai works it to deep square leg for a single.
Another dot ball! A fuller delivery outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai drives it to covers now.
A flatter and shorter delivery outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai punches it to covers.
On a length, outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai hangs back and pushes it to the off side. A single to end the over.
A yorker, outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai digs it out back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on middle. Najibullah Zadran whips it off his pads towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 200 comes up for Afghanistan!
Good change of pace from Kingma! A slower ball, on a length, outsdie off. Najibullah Zadran looks to block but he fails to get any bat on it.
Excellent running! Fuller in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran drills it through the cover region and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! A short ball, outside off. Najibullah Zadran stays back and bludgeons it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Vivian Kingma (8-0-29-0) is back into the attack.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran cuts it past the point fielder and collects a run.
Shorter outside off. Azmatullah Omarzai goes back and cuts it to deep point for a single. Azmatullah Omarzai is off the mark.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Azmatullah Omarzai keeps it out towards the off side.
On a length, around off. Azmatullah Omarzai looks to cut but it goes off the inner half of the blade onto the deck.
Azmatullah Omarzai walks in at number 6.

OUT! BOWLED! Aryan Dutt strikes and gets rid of Afghanistan's skipper, Hashmatullah Shahidi. This was a flatter ball, going on with the arm, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back to cut but he gets cramped for room as it is too close to cut. He misses and the ball crashes onto his off pole. A timely wicket for Netherlands.
Tossed up, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi skips down and drills it to the fielder at extra cover.
Aryan Dutt (3-0-17-0) is back into the attack now.
Looped up, on a length, around off.. Najibullah Zadran blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up, well outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi reaches out and slices it uppishly wide of the deep point fielder for a run.
On a length, drifting onto the pads. Najibullah Zadran nudges it to deep mid-wicket and settles for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Tossed up, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi charges down the track and drills it back past the bowler. The ball races away to the long off fence.
Tossed up, around off. Najibullah Zadran taps it to the off side and takes off for a run.
Colin Ackermann to continue. Netherlands skipper opting for the off-spinner to continue against two left-handers.
A short ball, around the rib-cage. Najibullah Zadran hops in crease, swivels and pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to cut but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards the off side for one.
Wide! Banged into the deck, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his pull and it is been called as a wide for height by the umpire.
A slower ball, into the deck, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi hangs back and cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
On a length, angling in from middle. Najibullah Zadran nudges it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Wide! Glover misses his line and spills this one down leg. Najibullah Zadran misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
FOUR! WOW! Stand and deliver! Good-length ball, just outside off. Najibullah Zadran stays back and carves it through the cover region for a boundary. Lovely timing on that shot!
Back of a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Brandon Glover (7-0-24-1) is back into the attack.
On a length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on a length, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi rocks back and pulls it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder. The batters come back for the second run.
Flatter and quicker, around leg. Najibullah Zadran turns it behind square on the leg side and takes off for a quick run.
Another ball, darted on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi nudges it to the leg side for a run.
Nicely tossed up, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi skips down the track and pushes it to cover.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Najibullah Zadran tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Time for Powerplay 3! Netherlands can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Short ball this time. Najibullah Zadran pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. So just a single off the Free Hit.
NO BALL! Vivian Kingma oversteps this time. A length ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it to sweeper cover for a single. Free Hit coming up.
Back of a length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it to backward point and the batters get back for two.
Shorter on middle. Najibullah Zadran pulls it again but this time miscues it. The ball goes in the air towards deep square leg but in the vacant area. A single taken.

Good work in the deep by Clayton Floyd! A shorter length delivery around leg. Najibullah Zadran pulls it to backward square leg. Clayton Floyd in the deep runs to his left and stops it with a dive. Two runs taken.
On a length, on off. Najibullah Zadran hits this firmly towards covers again.
Back of a length, on off. Najibullah Zadran punches it to covers now.
Shorter and quicker on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to cut but misses.
Good running! Flatter and quicker, around middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it wide of the long on fielder and comes back for the second run.
Tossed up, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Najibullah Zadran cuts it past the cover fielder for a run.
A short ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi rocks back and pulls it towards long on for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it to the fielder at cover.
Flatter ball, on middle. Najibullah Zadran keeps it out.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! This time it darted on the pads. Najibullah Zadran stays back and glances it past the short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Punished by Zadran! A half-tracker, around middle. Najibullah Zadran rocks back and pulls it wide of the long on fielder to bag a boundary.

Another halt in play. Najibullah Zadran dived full stretch to get inside the crease and looks like he has hurt himself in the process. The physio is out to have a check on him. He seems fine now and we are good to go.
Flatter ball, on off. Najibullah Zadran taps it to the off side.
A flatter delivery around leg. Zadran looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pad and there is an appeal from the bowler but turn down by the umpire.
Tossed up on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on middle. Najibullah Zadran blocks it out.
Nicely tossed up outside off this time. Najibullah Zadran defends it towards the off side.
A flatter delivery on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it to covers and another single is talen.
Another shorter length delivery on off. Najibullah Zadran punches it to covers for a single now.
Slightly shorter on off. Najibullah Zadran defends it onto the turf.
Nicely tossed up on middle. Najibullah Zadran drives it to covers.
Colin Ackermann comes to bowl now.
Flatter delivery on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it back to the bowler.
On the pads this time. Najibullah Zadran looks to work it away but misses. The ball hits his pads and a leg bye is taken towards short fine leg.
FOUR! This time he finds the gap! A fuller delivery outside off. Najibullah Zadran leans forward and creams the drive through covers for a boundary.
Unlucky for Najibullah Zadran! A fuller delivery on off. Najibullah Zadran drills it straight but the ball hits the stumps. So a dot ball.
Shorter length again on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter in length and turning into the batter. Hashmatullah Shahidi plays it back to the bowler.
Banged into the deck, around leg. Najibullah Zadran looks to pull but he fails to get any bat on it. Just 1 run off the over!
Back of a length, around leg. Najibullah Zadran stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and keeps it out.
On a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Shorter in length, just outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to cut but gets cramped for room. It goes off the inner half of the blade towards cover for a run.
Play and a miss! Back of a length, angling across the batter. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to punch it through cover but the ball goes past his blade.
Floated, on a length, around middle. Najibullah Zadran keeps it out.
FOUR! Nails his reverse sweep this time! Tossed up, around middle. Najibullah Zadran gets down on his knee and reverse sweeps it past the point fielder. The ball races away for a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but it is turned down by the umpire. Flatter ball, fuller in length, around off. Najibullah Zadran looks for a sweep but he misses and gets hit low on his pad.
Tossed up, around middle. Najibullah Zadran reverse sweeps it but straight to the fielder at backward point.

FOUR! Edgy, but Najibullah Zadran won't mind that at all! Flatter ball, around off and spinning away a bit. Najibullah Zadran stays back to block but it goes off the outside edge past the slip fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
Tossed up, around leg. Najibullah Zadran tucks it towards square leg.
Fuller in length, outside off. Najibullah Zadran prods and drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Najibullah Zadran hangs back and blocks it to the off side.

Drinks! Afghanistan have lost the big wicket of Rahmat Shah just at the stroke of Drinks! Afghanistan have gone about their business quite steadily so far and would be looking to up the ante now. Netherlands, on the other hand would be looking to chip in with wickets here to restrict Afghanistan to a low total.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brandon Glover strikes and this is a timely wicket for Netherlands! The new ball seems to have done wonders for the Dutch and Rahmat Shah is denied a fifty! This was a length ball, just outside off and curling away a bit. Rahmat Shah looks to drive on the up but it goes off the outer half of the blade, straight to Bas de Leede at backward point who takes a sharp catch by moving to his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Brandon Glover

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! Top delivery from Glover! Length ball, around the fourth stump channel and shaping away a bit. Rahmat Shah looks to defend but the bal beats past his outside edge.
Back of a length, just outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Length ball, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it to the fielder at cover.
Flatter on middle. Shah works it to square leg now.
Shorter and outside off again. Shah cuts it straight to backward point this time.
FOUR! Width on offer and it is punished! Shorter and outside off. Shah rocks back and cuts it. The ball beats the diving backward point fielder for a boundary.
Nicely tossed up on off. Shah skips down the track and defends it towards the off side.
Dutt goes fuller on leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery on off. Shah goes back and punches it to covers for a single. Good running.
A fuller delivery outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leaves it alone this time. There is good carry through to the keeper because of the new ball.

There seems to be a problem with the ball. Oh, dear! Vivian Kingma is caught tampering the ball. Pieter Seelaar is having a discussion with the on-field umpires. Five bonus runs for Afghanistan as Netherlands have been penalised here. The Dutch skipper is not happy with this decision. The ball is now being changed as well. Suprisingly, the umpires have given a brand new ball to Netherlands.
Back of a length, around off. Rahmat Shah stays back and steers it to third man for a single.
Good-length ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi carves it through the cover region and takes a single.
A slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to block but it goes off the outside edge and falls just short of the keeper.
Back of a length, around off. Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out to the off side.
On a length, on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi dabs it towards point.
Nicely tossed up outside off this time. Shah skips down the track and pushes it to covers this time.
A tossed up delivery on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it towards the mid on region and takes a quick single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shah eases it down to long on for a single.
Another full delivery, This time on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to drive it towards the off side but gets the inside half of his blade. The ball goes towards long on for a single.
A full delivery on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it to square leg now.
A low full toss around leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it to mid-wicket.
Another dot ball and just a run of a wide in this over! A length ball, on off. Shah charges down the track and hits it straight to mid off.
A slower bouncer outside off this time. Rahmat Shah looks to upper cut it but misses. Clever bowling this.
Brandon Glover hits the length hard again and bowls this on off. Shah defends this off the back foot towards the off side.
Brandon Glover goes fuller on middle now. Shah clips it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
A length ball, around off. Shah dabs it square off the wicket on the off side.
A fuller delivery this time. Shah drives it to short cover. The fielder there half-stops it but still a dot ball.
WIDE! On a length and down the leg side this time. Shah looks to clip it but misses.
A fuller delivery on off. Shah drives it to long off for a single.
Shorter in length on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi punches it to long on for a single.
A shorter length delivery on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi pulls it to square leg.
Hashmatullah Shahidi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Riaz Hussan departs after getting to his fifty. This has been a good knock but he has to walk back now. A tossed up delivery on middle. Riaz Hussan dances down the track and looks to go big across the line. He ends up getting an outside edge. The ball goes towards cover-point and the fielder there Bas de Leede takes an easy catch. So another wicket for a spinner.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Saqib Zulfiqar

Commentary.Commentary: A flatter delivery on middle. Riaz Hussan defends it this time.
A fuller delivery on middle. Shah sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Good delivery to end the over! A good-length delivery outside off. The ball seams away with extra bounce as Riaz Hussan looks to cut it.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side this time. Riaz Hussan looks to clip it but misses.
FOUR! What a way to get to your fifty on debut! Short and wide outside off. Riaz Hussan cuts it hard through point for a boundary. This has been a quality knock from the debutant.
Drifting on the pads this time. Shah works it to fine leg for a single.
On a length and that nips back in sharply. Shah looks to defend but gets hit high on the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side.
A length ball that is nipping into middle. Shah defends it towards the leg side.
On a length, outside off. Riaz Hussan drives it point. Good fielding there by the fielder. The batters run a risky single as the ball deflects off the body of the point fielder towards covers.
Brandon Glover is back on.
100 up for Afghanistan! A fuller delivery this time on off. Riaz Hussan skips down the track and plays it aerially towards sweeper cover for a single.
A shorter delivery again, outside off. Riaz Hussan cuts it to backward point this time.
Short and wide outside off. Riaz Hussan looks to cut it but gets the bottom of his blade and the ball goes towards covers.
Shorter outside off. Shah cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Nicely tossed up on off. Shah defends it towards the off side.
A fuller delivery on middle. Riaz Hussan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah looks to cut but he misses.
Length ball, around middle. Riaz Hussan clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length, around off. Riaz Hussan stays back and punches it towards cover.
Wide! Kingma errs in line and spills this one down leg. Riaz Hussan misses his flick and the umpire calls it as a wide.
There seems to be some issue with the ball! They are now satisfied that it is good enough to continue and we are ready to resume.
Short of a length, just outside off. Rahmat Shah stays back and taps it towards backward point.
Fuller in length, around off. Rahmat Shah drives it back to the bowler.
Short of a length, around off. Riaz Hussan stays back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and wider outside off. Riaz Hussan drives it wide of cover for a single.

In the air...but over the fielder at mid on. This is fuller on off. Riaz Hussan skips down the track and chips it over mid on. He miscues it a little but still gets it over the infield. Two runs taken.
Another delivery that is darted on middle. Shah clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Riaz Hussan sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle. Shah works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, fuller in length, around leg. Riaz Hussan sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Saqib Zulfiqar is into the attack now. Leg-spinner replacing another leg-spinner.
On a length, around off. Riaz Hussan pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good-length ball, around off. Riaz Hussan blocks it to the off side.
Back of a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah stays back and steers it to third man for a run.

In the air...but falls just short of the fielder. Back of a length, around off. Rahmat Shah looks to pull but he miscues it towards the mid off region as it goes off the toe end of the bat. The ball falls just short of the mid off fielder who runs in to grab it. Shah escapes yet again.
A bit fuller in length this time, around middle. Rahmat Shah pushes it towards mid on.
Kingma starts with a length ball, angling in from middle. Rahmat Shah tucks it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Vivian Kingma (4-0-12-0) is back into the attack now.
Tossed up, outside off. Rahmat Shah drives it towards deep cover for a run.
A low full toss, around off. Riaz Hussan skips down the track and heaves it to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Nicely played! Flatter and quicker, around off. Riaz Hussan stays back, opens the face of his bat and steers it past the third man fielder for a boundary.
Flatter ball, going on with the arm, around middle. Riaz Hussan misses his flick and gets hit high on his pad.
Fuller in length, outside off. Rahmat Shah drills it towards long off for a run.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Riaz Hussan stays back and  cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
Floated, on a length, around off. Riaz Hussan works it through covers for a single.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Riaz Hussan keeps it out.
On a length, around off. Rahmat Shah tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on a length, outside off. Rahmat Shah cuts it to the fielder at backward point.
On a length, outside off. Riaz Hussan pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Flatter ball, around leg. Riaz Hussan tucks it behind square on the leg side  side for a couple of runs. Oh, dear! The umpire signals for a short run so it will be just the single.
Flatter and quicker on the middle again. Riaz Hussan works it to fine leg and takes a single.
Drifting on the pads this time. Shah works it to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! A rare bad delivery and punished! A shorter length delivery on off. Shah rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. The pressure that was building from three dot balls has been released now.
Three dots in a row! Shorter and outside off. Shah cuts it to backward point.
Shorter in length, outside off this time. Shah punches this off the back foot to covers now.
Nicely tossed up on off. Shah drives it to short cover.

Drinks! This has been quite a tidy start from the Dutch bowlers. The debutant, Clayton Floyd has been excellent with the ball and he has managed to take the wicket of Gurbaz, the centurion of the last game. Shah and Hussan will now look to rotate the strike and keep the scoreboard ticking. Netherlands will need to chip in with wickets as they cannot allow Afghanistan's batters to settle in.
Shorter in length, outside off. Riaz Hussan blocks it towards the off side.

NOT OUT! Shah survives and benefit of doubt goes to the batter! A nicely tossed up delivery, outside off. Shah looks to defend but gets beaten as the ball turns away sharply. He is little off-balance in his push and Scott Edwards behind the stumps whips the bails off. There is an appeal for stumping and the umpire goes upstairs. The TV umpire takes a lot of time to make his decision but in the end decides that Shah had some part of his foot inside the crease. So Rahmat Shah survives!

Stumping-check! Scott Edwards has whipped the bails off in a flash and Rahmat Shah could be in trouble here. He was drawn forward to drive but has missed it. Edwards was quick behind the sticks to collect the ball and whips the bails off. The replays roll in and it looks very tight. A tricky one for the TV umpire. The decision could well-go in the batter's favour here! The TV umpire is taking his own sweet time to make his decision. Ahh, the decision does go in Shah's favour and he survives.

Commentary.Howout: c Pieter Seelaar b Clayton Floyd

We are set for the game to begin! The players of Netherlands stride out to the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Riaz Hussan will open the batting for Afghanistan. Vivian Kingma will start with the ball. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Hamid Hasan is near the pitch. He says that the wicket is looking flat and batting first will be crucial to win the game. He adds that there are cracks but they are not alarming and this pitch is a little different from the other two pitches.

Pieter Seelaar, the skipper of Netherlands, says that they would have batted first. Adds that the pitch seems to be playing good in the morning. Tells that they have some positives in this series and they will look to play well and hard in this match. Tells that they have made three changes to their side.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says that they will bat first. He adds that the pitch looks different from the first two games. He mentions that the pitch is slower and lower and they are trying to bring their spinners into play. He informs that they have made four changes to their side.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Pieter Seelaar (C), Colin Ackermann, Brandon Glover (In for Musa Ahmed), Scott Edwards (WK), Vivian Kingma, Bas de Leede, Philippe Boissevain, Saqib Zulfiqar, Boris Gorlee, Clayton Floyd (On debut) (In for Ryan Klein), Aryan Dutt (In for Fred Klaassen).

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Riaz Hussan (On debut) (In for Usman Ghani), Azmatullah Omarzai (In for Gulbadin Naib), Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Qais Ahmad (On debut) (In for Sharafuddin Ashraf), Fareed Ahmad, Fazal Haque (On debut) (In for Yamin Ahmadzai).
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Netherlands, on the other hand, were always going to find it difficult against the quality of Afghan bowling attack. The credit should be given to their bowlers who have been quite effective in the series so far and have managed to restrict Afghanistan to a chaseable total. However, the batting apart from Scott Edwards has failed to step up and Netherlands have never looked like chasing a total in the two ODIs so far. They have some experienced players like Colin Ackermann and Pieter Seelaar in their unit and unless they take more responsibility, the story of the first two ODIs is likely to continue. Can Netherlands put a spirited performance and avoid a whitewash here? Or Will Afghans continue to march on? Stay tuned. Toss and teams sheets in a while.

Afghanistan have been clinical in the series so far. The batting group has managed to put decent scores on the board with skipper Hashmatullah Shahidi notching up fifties in both the games. The young and talented Rahmanullah Gurbaz displayed his talent in the second ODI with a superb century while Rahmat Shah, one of the most technically correct batters in Afghanistan, has also been in fine touch. The real threat for the opponent though has been their bowling attack and the quality of Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Rashid Khan has been too hot to handle for the Dutch. They will hope that the domination continues in this final ODI.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final ODI of this three-match ODI series between Afghanistan and Netherlands. Afghanistan have already sealed the series and have grabbed crucial 20 points in the World Cup Super League on the way. Netherlands, on the other hand, have failed to challenge Afghanistan consistently to produce positive results and will be looking to end the series on a high. This match provides another opportunity for both these teams to bag 10 vital points in the World Cup Super League and it will be interesting to see how things pan out in this final game of the series.
